scope: Offline review of MPPI command capture, delivery gate, Piper health/command lease and base UART; no ROS nodes, CAN calls or motion commands.

confirmed_defect.problem: A cycle-start timestamp was used after lock acquisition to validate newer callback samples. Scheduler/lock delays beyond 5 ms could make fresh feedback look future-dated, forcing a zero command; genuinely expired state could also enter an avoidable solve.

reproduction.after: capture and command delivery succeed with original command stamp 100.0

confirmed_defect.fix: Read ROS current time inside capture lock, execution-authority lock and native handoff observation lock; preserve source command stamp, deadline, freshness thresholds and original arm startup command flow.
confirmed_defect.after_test_result: 9 tests passed including native handoff observation clock
confirmed_defect.related_regression: 13 execution gate/delivery tests and 30 startup tests passed
confirmed_defect.hardware_causation_limit: Deterministic software defect; existing recording does not identify which real stops were caused by this race.
confirmed_defect.native_gate_regression: Two of three additional tests failed before the one-line native observation clock correction; genuine future joints rejected before and after. Native startup sends no commands and remains incomplete until normal handoff.

recorded_evidence.scope: Earlier 17:18 run at 0.05 m/s, not current 0.20 m/s revision
recorded_evidence.actual_health_or_geometry_failure: Do not suppress these stops or prolong source validity to hide symptoms.

reviewed_unchanged: reject sends zero base command immediately. This explains visible stop/go, but allowing stale-map motion is not a valid repair.
Piper execution health is already independent of last command lease, while healthy idle retains bounded target. No further arm driver change justified by this audit.
base_control uses separate short-timeout RX and fixed 50 Hz TX with 0.30 s watchdog; no reproducible transport defect found in available evidence.
Delivery retains latest geometry + braking checks and final feedback/health/deadline checks.
